basic_info.description: Elegant and rare 3 unit residence that can easily live as a two-level trophy home with au pair unit. Fully vacant and ready to move in. Over 16 rooms including: 3 chef kitchens, 5 bathrooms, 6+ bedrooms, and ample living and entertaining spaces. Remodeled with love and care, including full foundation upgrade, updated electric, plumbing, fire sprinklers, and sewer lines to street. Rare 16th century Tudor fireplace, hand stenciled ceilings, new painting and Murano glass lighting! Large private garden with gazebo and enclosed sun room, 2 car garage. An easy walk to Haight/Ashbury + Cole Valley's many great shops, and restaurants. Must see in person, spectacular and unique features make this residence a one-of-a-kind dream home or trophy investment for buyers with discerning tastes.
